property_summary: Any two successful 10-ether payouts in blocks n1<n2 must occur at blocks whose difference is a multiple of 15 (reference pays only on multiples of 15); the mutant, paying on multiples of 7, can pay at blocks 7 and 14, whose difference 7 is not a multiple of 15.
change_summary: Change the modulo divisor from 15 to 7 in the payout condition.
